credit.a: A credit is one minute of video you upload. A 60-minute podcast uses 60 credits, whether it yields 5 clips or 20. Clips, exports and posts don’t use credits.

outOfCredits.q: What happens if I run out of credits?
outOfCredits.a: You can keep editing and publishing what you already have. To upload more video, wait for your renewal or upgrade your plan; on Business you can add credits without changing plans. Unused minutes don’t roll over to the next month.

changePlan.a: Yes. If you upgrade, you only pay the prorated part of the cycle and the new credits are added right away. If you downgrade, the change applies at the end of the current cycle.

annualBilling.a: You pay for the year upfront with a 50% discount on the monthly price. Credits are delivered every month, not all at once.

cancelRefund.q: Can I cancel? Are there refunds?
cancelRefund.a: You cancel from Settings, with no calls or commitment, and keep your plan until the end of the paid cycle. If it’s your first payment and you haven’t used more than 30 credits, we’ll refund you within the following 7 days.

currencyTaxes.q: What currency are you charged in, and what about taxes?
currencyTaxes.a: Prices are in US dollars (US$) and exclude taxes: IGV or VAT is calculated at checkout based on your country. We accept cards and, in Peru, Yape and Plin.

teamSeats.q: How are team members billed on Business?
teamSeats.a: Each additional member is billed per seat, on the same cycle as the plan. Seats share the workspace’s credits and storage.

afterCancel.q: What happens to my videos if I cancel?
afterCancel.a: You can download all your material for 30 days after canceling. We don’t use your content to train models or share it with third parties.
